art_direction: 两条厚黑上弧与黑瞳相连，短下笔、白色钝缺口，无眉配略歪平嘴。
composition: centered hand-drawn eye pair; auxiliary marks only when specified; large blank paper margins

color_randomization.method: golden-angle hue spacing with seeded single-hue saturation and lightness variation

color_treatment: one opaque flat color beside each pupil; no gradient or shaded rendering
creative_direction: Two thick curved upper strokes join directly into the large black pupils. Add a short lower brush mark under each opening, leaving both eye contours unfinished. Reserve a blunt white notch cut into each black mass, not a round highlight. The left eye is a little longer and lower; both gaze ahead. Keep one short, almost level mouth with a slight lean. No brows. Let the flat brush leave unequal stroke ends, with no surface noise.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
